# Scanly — full content for language models

> Free, open-source document scanner for Android by TheKubics. Offline-first, no account, bring your own cloud storage. This file contains the substantive content of https://scanly.thekubics.space/ in plain markdown, for retrieval and citation.

Canonical URL: https://scanly.thekubics.space/
Source repository: https://github.com/TheKubics-org/Scanly
Platform: Android 7.0 (API 24) and later
Latest release referenced on this site: v2.2.2
Licence: open source (see repository LICENSE)

---

## Positioning

Scanly is a focused document scanner. It does one job well: turning physical paper into clean, correct digital files. It deliberately omits the account system, cloud mandate, and subscription tier that characterise commercial scanner apps, on the grounds that a scanner should not need to be trusted with your documents to be useful.

The cloud integration is bring-your-own-storage. Credentials belong to the user, files go straight from the device to a provider the user already has an account with, and TheKubics operates no server that receives document content.

## Section 01 — The product

Scanly focuses on the part that matters: turning physical documents into clean, useful digital files. Scan, enhance, organize, and export from one focused workspace.

The workflow runs in four stages: capture, clean, compose, export. Capture takes a page from the camera or the gallery. Clean applies automatic edge detection, perspective correction, and enhancement. Compose assembles multiple captures into a single ordered document. Export produces PDF or JPEG.

## Section 02 — Capabilities

Eight core features:

**01 Smart Scanning.** Capture documents using the physical device camera, or import existing gallery images, with zero quality degradation.

**02 Auto Crop.** Real-time quad-corner contour detection with pixel-precise edge snapping around physical document boundaries. Runs on-device, so no image leaves the phone to be analysed.

**03 Perspective Correction.** A planar homography transformation straightens angled captures into planar, front-facing document surfaces.

**04 Enhancement.** Improves readability with professional ColourMatrix processing. Filters: Auto Enhance, Grayscale, B&W, Hi-Contrast, Color Boost, Sharpen.

**05 Multi-Page Composition.** Builds complete documents from multiple scans. Add, reorder, rotate, duplicate, and merge pages.

**06 PDF Export.** Turns scanned pages into PDF files with configurable page sizes (A4, Letter) and compression tiers.

**07 Document Library.** A local Room/SQLite database keeps all scans searchable, taggable, grouped into folders, and lockable behind device biometrics.

**08 Cloud Storage.** Backs up documents to storage the user already owns — Telegram, S3/R2, or Google Drive — via WorkManager background workers, with an offline queue so uploads resume when connectivity returns.

## Section 03 — Interface

The camera viewfinder shows live document detection. Corner brackets track the detected quad, a status tag reports the detection state, and a pill confirms the locked paper size (for example A4). A laser line sweeps the frame to signal active scanning. Controls sit below the viewfinder: gallery import, a shutter control, and flash.

An interactive enhancement preview lets the user drive brightness and contrast sliders and see the effect on a sample page rendered live in the browser, so filter behaviour can be evaluated before installing.

The composer demonstrates multi-page assembly: add, reorder, rotate, and duplicate operations on a set of captured pages.

## Section 04 — Workflow

SCAN, AUTO-CROP, ENHANCE, COMPOSE, EXPORT. Each stage is independently reachable, and the document library keeps every intermediate result, so a user can return to a scan and re-run a later stage without recapturing.

## Section 05 — Cloud storage

Scanly is bring-your-own-storage (BYOS). Three backends are supported:

- **Telegram** — Telegram Bot API, authenticated with a bot token the user supplies. Endpoint: `api.telegram.org`.
- **Cloudflare R2 / S3-compatible** — authenticated with an access key and secret. Endpoint: `<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`. Works with any S3-compatible object store.
- **Google Drive** — authenticated with a service-account credentials JSON. Endpoint: `googleapis.com/drive/v3`.

Credentials are stored on-device. Because the user supplies them, documents are transmitted directly to the provider the user chose, under that provider's terms. TheKubics neither receives nor stores document content.

## Section 06 — Stack

Core scanner: ML Kit for on-device document edge detection, Jetpack Compose for the interface, CameraX for capture, ColourMatrix for image processing, and a homography transform for perspective correction.

Cloud and intelligence: Telegram Bot API, S3/R2 object storage, and Google Drive, driven by WorkManager with offline queueing.

Ecosystem: Kotlin, Room for persistence, WorkManager for deferred work, and Android Keystore / hardware-backed keys for protecting stored credentials.

## Section 07 — Privacy

The application collects no personal information. No analytics SDK, no advertising SDK, no crash-reporting service, and no telemetry. Scanning, enhancement, composition, and PDF export all function with no network connection and no account.

Documents remain in app-private storage until the user deletes them. Deleting a document, or purging trash, wipes the associated files immediately. Uninstalling removes all internal databases, cache files, and stored credentials.

Optional cloud sync is user-initiated and user-configured, targeting only a provider the user nominates with their own credentials.

Security architecture: master keys are generated inside the device hardware security module (Secure Element / TEE); the window can optionally set FLAG_SECURE to block screenshots and app-switcher previews; and storage follows modern Android scoped-storage and backup-extraction rules.

## Section 08 — Roadmap

Core scanner work, cloud and intelligence integrations, and ecosystem items are tracked in the public repository. The project ships free with no paid tier.

## Website technical facts

This site is a static build. It sets no cookies, runs no analytics, embeds no third-party JavaScript, and self-hosts its typefaces, so loading a page discloses no visitor IP address or referrer to any third party. The only client-side storage is the theme preference under the `localStorage` key `scanly-theme`. Hosting is GitHub Pages.
